desc:
⚡ Turbo Tag ⚡

Classic tag with a twist: every runner you catch joins the taggers.

Runners: stay alive until the timer runs out.
Taggers: catch everyone before it does.

• Unlock abilities like Dash, Super Jump, Invisibility and Black Hole
• Turbo Rounds mix things up with super speed, tiny players, giant taggers and more
• Vote on the next map, then race the lobby obby between rounds
• Earn coins every round and spend them on auras, titles and emotes
• Check the Daily Shop for new picks every day
• Claim daily rewards, finish quests and climb the leaderboards

Bring your friends and see who lasts the longest.

Turbo Tag is still growing! Found a bug? Let us know through the Feedback guy in the lobby.
